lines: Before my training I did three helpdesk internships, two school internships and one voluntary one, all unpaid and all just because I enjoyed the work.
I produced over 2,000 YouTube videos and streamed live for hundreds of hours, which taught me community building, live technology, video production, consistency and dealing with feedback.
ShadowUnity runs at play.shadowunity.de and hasn't had a reset since 2022.
-Its plot system is streuland, my Paper plugin for protected vanilla-style plots instead of a standard grid: https://github.com/drosemann/streuland

+Its plot system is streuland, my open-source Paper 1.16.5 plugin for protected vanilla-style plots randomly scattered through a normal Minecraft world instead of a standard grid, automatically connected by paths and extended with districts, clans, a market, plot upgrades and YAML and SQLite storage: https://github.com/drosemann/streuland

Its name history is GrieferPrinz from the Pocket Edition days, inspired by GrieferKing and GrieferGames, then MelonenGames as my first Java server with only CityBuild, then DiamantSucht because that was my in game name, then DanielArmy during a personal brand phase, then MineRush, inspired by MineSucht by Abge and FloTastisch, and finally ShadowUnity, from ShadowFox plus community, which has been stable ever since.
From 24 January 2025 to 26 April 2025 I ran the DMH Network together with Matti and Henry.
Under my old alias MineHub I published SpigotMC plugins at https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/authors/minehub.1035036/
